summary: Inside the gateway, the Envoy proxy routes and authorizes requests with about 10 ms latency; the gRPC authentication service validates each request (except /api/gateway/v1/ routes, which the gateway API authenticates) and can add latency when its GRPC_SERVER_PROCESSES and GRPC_SERVER_MAX_THREADS_PER_PROCESS workers are busy or session database lookups are slow.
questions: How much latency does the platform gateway Envoy proxy add?
Why are AAP API requests queueing at authentication?
